text: Entry2132 routes sync title/details/option spacing and decorative icon size/resources through component variables. Compact selects24px assets; base selects32px assets. Touch overrides some gaps/option padding and inherits the unoverridden base icon/title-padding values. Fixed0b93 retains this mapping with logical dimensions. The review reports compact/high-font Select All overlap without an explicit resolution; acceptance alone is not evidence it was fixed. Existing stacking/control lessons remain scoped and unchanged. No density, font-size or accessibility run occurred.
title: Account Hub sync density selects assets and spacing without proving the reported overlap fixed
